content.text: {"id": "mm7048a6", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "52.8% reported symptoms of at least one mental health condition in the past 2 weeks"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Public health workers who reported being unable to take time off from work were more likely to report adverse mental health symptoms."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalences of symptoms of depression, anxiety, PTSD, and suicidal ideation were 30.8%, 30.3%, 36.8%, and 8.4%"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 52.8% of respondents reported symptoms of at least one adverse mental health condition"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Public health workers who reported being unable to take time off from work were more likely to report adverse mental health symptoms."}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Referent group for all prevalence ratio calculations was not experiencing the traumatic event/stressor"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "a nonprobability–based online survey was conducted during March 29–April 16, 2021"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Univariate prevalence ratios were calculated using Poisson regression with 95% confidence intervals estimated using a robust standard error."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Prevalence of symptoms of mental health conditions and suicidal ideation were assessed by demographic characteristics and workplace factors."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Mental health symptoms were evaluated using the 9-item Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-9) for depression"}, {"loc": "table 2", "q": "Referent group for all prevalence ratio calculations was not experiencing the traumatic event/stressor"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
